launcher.intro: Scans the vanilla Skyrim SE Data folder for every record whose EditorID or mesh path mentions snow, duplicates the winning mesh for each one, and writes a plugin pointing at the duplicates - so they stay freely editable without touching any original asset.

landscapeVertexColors.label: Landscape Vertex Colors
landscapeVertexColors.help: Clears baked-in vertex color tinting on terrain (LAND) records, so they render standalone instead of carrying leftover color grading meant for a different look.
landscapeVertexColors.snow: Clear only where a snow-classified texture is used

meshVertexColors.label: Mesh Vertex Colors
meshVertexColors.help: Clears baked-in vertex color tinting on landscape-folder meshes (rocks, cliffs, icebergs, ...), including DLC variants under DLC01\Landscape\, DLC02\Landscape\, etc.
meshVertexColors.snowOnly: Only on the generated snow meshes
meshVertexColors.all: On all landscape meshes, including non-snow originals

collisionMaterial.label: Collision Material (Footstep Sounds)
collisionMaterial.help: Remaps collision materials on the generated snow meshes toward their snow equivalent (currently just Dirt/Grass -> Snow) so footstep sounds match the snowy visual. Works per collision chunk, so unrelated materials in the same mesh are left alone.
collisionMaterial.snowOnly: Apply on the generated snow meshes

meshBlacklist.label: Mesh Blacklist
meshBlacklist.help: Meshes matching a rule here are never duplicated or patched. Wildcards (*) allowed, e.g. "*\trees\*". Right click to add/remove rows.

editorIdKeywords.label: EditorID Blacklist Keywords
editorIdKeywords.help: Records whose EditorID contains one of these words (case-insensitive) are skipped entirely - useful for excluding false-positive matches. Right click to add/remove rows.

dirtCliffsSnowVariant.label: DirtCliffsRoots Snow Variant
dirtCliffsSnowVariant.checkbox: Generate a snow variant of DirtCliffsRoots01 texture
dirtCliffsSnowVariant.help: Generates the texture file(s) and applies them to the "Skirt" part of the generated DirtCliffs meshes.

mountainSlabMask.label: MountainSlab Mask Swap
mountainSlabMask.checkbox: Swap MountainSlab01/02 for their Mask variant on snow-named meshes
mountainSlabMask.help: For a record whose EditorID ends in "Snow"/"SN", repoints any shape using MountainSlab01/02 to its "...Mask" sibling, when one exists on disk.

hideDecalShapes.label: Hide Decal Shapes
hideDecalShapes.checkbox: Hide Rocks01/SnowRocks01 shapes on mountain/rock/tundra meshes
hideDecalShapes.help: Avoids z-fighting with Skyrim's own decal-based dynamic snow shaders by hiding any shape textured with "Rocks01"/"SnowRocks01", on mountain/rock/tundra meshes only. Hides the shape instead of deleting it, so no plugin changes are needed. Does not affect DirtCliffs meshes.

removeIceSnowMaterial.label: Ice Snow Material
removeIceSnowMaterial.checkbox: Remove the glacier snow material from statics
removeIceSnowMaterial.help: Clears the SnowMaterialGlacier / SnowMaterialGlacierSlab Material Object from every static that uses it, so no snow is projected on glaciers and ice. Only changes SnowFixer.esp - no mesh is modified, and the ice's own shader material is left alone.
